name: Pro Medicus Limited
summary: Pro Medicus Limited, a healthcare informatics company, provides medical imaging software and services to hospitals, imaging centers, and health care groups in Australia, Europe, and North America. The company offers Visage RIS, an enterprise-class radiology information system for patient registration, billing, scheduling, typing, HL7 integration, financial reporting, picture archive and communication system (PACS) integration, digital dictation, and voice recognition integration; and Visage RIS/PACS, a solution for imaging needs of organizations.
